nodes.label: /root/moodle-credentials.txt
nodes.rationale: Admin and database passwords are random and stored in the container.

nodes.label: Proxmox VE Community Scripts style menus
nodes.norm_label: proxmox ve community scripts style menus

nodes.label: Summary Screen before creation
nodes.rationale: Shows everything before anything is created; Exit at any step changes nothing, so aborting is safe.

nodes.label: Backup to /var/backups/moodle (newest 3 kept)
nodes.rationale: Database and code backed up before Moodle changes so a failed upgrade restores previous code and database; moodledata is excluded, so Proxmox backups are still needed.

nodes.label: PHP switch with rollback
nodes.rationale: Switches back if Moodle's environment checks fail after moving to a newer PHP.

nodes.label: $CFG->sslproxy
nodes.rationale: Set because TLS terminates at the reverse proxy while the container serves plain HTTP on port 80.

nodes.label: local/adduser plugin
nodes.rationale: Replaces Moodle's Add a new user form to require a unique ID number and enrol in multiple courses at once; edit, bulk upload and self-registration still use Moodle's own forms.

nodes.label: Enrol in multiple courses (manual enrolment, default role)
nodes.norm_label: enrol in multiple courses (manual enrolment, default role)

nodes.label: Major Moodle version upgrade (separate confirmation)
nodes.rationale: Minor builds are part of a normal update; a major version needs a separate yes because it brings new PHP and MariaDB requirements.

nodes.label: Runtime Version Lookup
nodes.rationale: Versions are resolved when the script runs (newest Moodle release with download package, its max supported PHP, its minimum MariaDB from environment.xml) so the installer stays current without edits; falls back to Moodle 5.3 / PHP 8.4 / MariaDB 11.4 offline.
